'''Roly Melusar's office''' was the office of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Roly Melusar]] of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], which was a part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. It was located within the [[Special Operations barracks]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
